players.bio: Adrien Tameze (born 4 February 1994) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defender in Italy for Torino . Tameze is of Cameroonian descent.

Alberto Andrea Paleari (born 29 August 1992) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Torino. Club career Early career Born in Giussano, Lombardy, Paleari started his career at hometown club Seregno. In June 2008 he signed for Serie A club a.C. Milan. He was the starting keeper of Primavera under-20 team from 2008–09 to 2010–11 season.
Alessio Cacciamani is an 18-year-old Italian professional footballer who currently plays as a left winger for SS Juve Stabia in Serie B. He is on a "dry loan" from Torino FC until 30 June 2026.

Ali Bina Dembélé (born 5 January 2004) is a French professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Serie A club Torino. Career A youth product of FC du Bourget, Dembélé signed a youth contract with Troyes on 15 June 2017, and was promoted to their reserves in 2021. In October 2022, he transferred to Torino where he played in their Primavera side.
Alieu Eybi Njie (born 14 May 2005) is a Swedish footballer who plays as a winger for Torino.
Ardian Ilmi Ismajli (born 30 September 1996) is an Albanian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Italian Serie A Torino.
Cesare Casadei (born 10 January 2003) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Serie A club Torino.

Ché Zach Everton Fred Adams (born 13 July 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for Torino and the Scotland national team. He began his senior career in non-league football with Oadby Town and Ilkeston before moving into the Football League with Sheffield United in late 2014. He made 47 League One appearances before signing for Birmingham in August 2016.
Cristiano Biraghi (born 1 September 1992) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Serie A club Torino and the Italy national team.

Cyril Ngonge (born 26 May 2000) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays for Italian Serie A club Torino as a winger or forward. Club career Ngonge is a youth exponent from Club Brugge. He made his senior debut on 2 December 2018 in the Belgian Pro League against Standard Liège. He replaced Emmanuel Dennis after 20 minutes.
Daniel Santos Bragança (born 27 May 1999) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Sporting CP.

Duván Esteban Zapata Banguero (born 1 April 1991) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Italian club Torino and the Colombia national team. After starting his career with Colombian club América de Cali, he later played for Estudiantes in Argentina, before moving to Italy, where he played for a number of teams, including Napoli, Udinese, Sampdoria, and Atalanta.
Emirhan İlkhan (born 6 January 2004) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Basaksehir on loan from Serie A club Torino.
Eray Ervin Cömert (born 4 February 1998) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Spanish club Valencia and the Switzerland national team.

Faustino Adebola Rasheed "Tino" Anjorin (born 23 November 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or left winger for Serie A club Torino, on loan from Empoli. Club career Anjorin joined Chelsea's development centre programme at under-7 level, officially signing with the club at under-9 level.

Franco Israel Wibmer (born 22 April 2000) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club Torino and the Uruguay national team. Israel is a former Uruguay youth international. He has represented Uruguay at several tournaments including the 2019 South American U-20 Championship and 2019 FIFA U-20 World Cup.
Gaetano Oristano is an Italian football player midfielder for Parma on loan from Venezia.

Giovanni Pablo Simeone Baldini (born 5 July 1995), also known as Gio Simeone or "El Cholito", is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a striker for Serie A club Torino, on loan from Napoli. The son of former Argentine international footballer Diego Simeone and Carolina Baldini, Giovanni Simeone was born in Buenos Aires, Argentina, while his father was playing for Atlético Madrid.

Gvidas Gineitis (born 15 April 2004) is a Lithuanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Torino and the Lithuania national team. In January 2023, he received the Best Young Lithuanian Footballer of the Year award by the Lithuanian Football Federation.
Ismael Konate (born 29 March 2006) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Empoli. Born in Ivory Coast, he is an Italy youth international.

Kian Franklin Fitz-Jim (born 5 July 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who currently plays as a defensive midfielder for Eredivisie club Ajax. On 18 June 2019, Fitz-Jim signed with AFC Ajax. he made his professional debut with Jong Ajax in a 2–1 Eerste Divisie loss to SC Telstar on 21 December 2020. He made his senior team debut in a friendly against FC Utrecht on 24 March 2021.
Lucas Estella Perri (born 10 December 1997) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Leeds United.
Marco Baroni (born 11 September 1963) is an Italian football manager and former player who played as a defender. He is currently in charge of Serie A club Torino.
Marcus Holmgren Pedersen (born 16 July 2000) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Italian Serie A club Torino and the Norway national team.

Nathan Kenneth Patterson is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Serie A side Torino and the Scotland national team. Club career On 21 December 2019, Patterson signed a new Rangers contract, keeping him at the club until 2022. He made his debut on 17 January 2020, in a Scottish Cup match against Stranraer at Ibrox Stadium.

Nikola Vlašić (born 4 October 1997) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Italian Serie A club Torino and the Croatia national team. Born in the famous Croatian sports family Vlašić, Nikola is a youth product of Hajduk Split academy. He made his senior debut in summer 2014, making The Guardian's Next Generation list later that year.
Pietro Comuzzo (born 20 February 2005) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Fiorentina.

Pietro Pellegri (born 17 March 2001) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Serie A club Empoli, on loan from Torino, and the Italy national team. In 2016, at the age of 15 years and 280 days, Pellegri joined Amedeo Amadei as the joint-youngest player to appear in Serie A at the time.
Rafik Belghali (born 7 June 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Italian Serie A club Hellas Verona. Born in Belgium, he represents Algeria at international level.

Ricardo Ivan Rodriguez Araya (born 25 August 1992) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Serie A club Torino and the Switzerland national team. Rodriguez began his professional career at local club FC Zürich in 2010, having spent eight years in the youth setup.

Rolando Mandragora (born 29 June 1997) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Fiorentina. He began his professional career at Genoa, making five Serie A appearances and playing more frequently on loan at Pescara in Serie B. In 2016 he joined Juventus, where he made a sole appearance and was loaned a year later to Crotone, where he played regularly.
Sandro Kulenović (Croatian pronunciation: ; born 4 December 1999) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Dinamo Zagreb.

Saúl Basilio Coco-Bassey Oubiña (born 9 February 1999), better known as Saúl Coco, is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Torino. Born in Spain, he represents Equatorial Guinea at international level.

Valentino Lando Lazaro (born 24 March 1996) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a wide midfielder, full-back, or winger for Serie A club Torino. Lazaro made his senior debut for the Austria national team 30 May 2014 in a 1–1 friendly draw against Iceland in Innsbruck, replacing Marko Arnautović for the last fifteen minutes.
Zakaria Aboukhlal (born 18 February 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as right winger for Italian Serie A club Torino. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Morocco national team.

Zanos Savva (Greek: Ζανος Σαββα; born 26 November 2005) is a Cypriot professional footballer who plays as a winger for Italian Serie A club Torino. Career Savva started his career with Cypriot side Olympiakos Nicosia. In 2022, he signed for Italian Serie A side Torino. Style of play Savva mainly operates as a winger. He is left-footed. Personal life Savva was born in 2005 in Nicosia, Cyprus.
